guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (right-handed, played upside-down/restrung for left hand)
guitar.evidence: Jimi Hendrix's white Fender Stratocaster (and his left-handed restringing of right-handed Strats) is among the most iconic and exhaustively documented guitar setups in rock history.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; one of the most famous guitar/guitarist pairings in music history.

tone.target: wah-fuzz Hendrix lead with biting upper mids
tone.profile: wah-fuzz Hendrix lead with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A powerful signal chain utilizing a Fuzz distortion for girth, followed by a Wah pedal sweep, feeding into a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model with a Marshall-style cabinet, enhanced by moderate spring reverb and EQ shaping for bite.

rig.name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Voodoo Child (Slight Return) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in high-gain fuzz tones.
blocks.gap: None. Gate 2 is suitable for general noise gating.

blocks.purpose: Provide a slight boost and mid-hump to help the fuzz cut through the mix without losing natural dynamics.
blocks.gap: The Fuzz Face is better modeled by Distortion or Fuzz, but Green OD offers a usable pre-boost stage before the main distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the thick, saturated sound of a Fuzz Face, providing the core psychedelic grit.
blocks.gap: None. This is the primary tone element.

blocks.purpose: Execute the signature wah sweeps and filter effects central to Hendrix's style.
blocks.gap: None. V-Wah is ideal for expressive, sweeping filters.

blocks.purpose: Model the classic Plexi/Marshall tone required for high-powered British rock, emphasizing upper mids.
blocks.gap: None. UK 45 is the best fit for this genre and era.

blocks.purpose: Provide the characteristic British cabinet sound and punch needed for the Plexi tone.
blocks.gap: None. Matches the UK 45 amp model well.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone by boosting upper mids and highs to achieve the 'biting' quality required.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for shaping the final aggressive lead tone.

blocks.purpose: Add the classic, slightly metallic 'singing sustain' and vintage ambiance associated with psychedelic rock.
blocks.gap: None. Spring reverb is a staple of this genre.

blocks.purpose: Keep delay minimal as requested by the musical verdict to maintain focus on fuzz and wah.
blocks.gap: The verdict suggests keeping delay minimal, so this block is included but deactivated/set low.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the vintage, open-air sound of a Plexi/Marshall stack.

proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage, open-air character of the Marshall sound.
